selected_question: After a provider may have committed but its acknowledgement is lost, can Frank preserve exactly one external effect while separating new execution authority from read-only outcome reconciliation, and is the historical downstream_retry_safe boolean strong enough to encode provider retry semantics?
hypothesis: Provider retry safety requires a typed, provenance-bound provider idempotency contract: stable provider request identity + exact semantic request fingerprint + scope/retention + mismatch behavior + duplicate-result semantics + read-only reconciliation. A bare downstream_retry_safe boolean is insufficient.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The existing stable idempotency key plus downstream_retry_safe boolean and V14 reconciliation are sufficient; additional typed provider semantics add complexity without changing safety.

fresh_external_primary_evidence.relevant_delta: Request identity is the mechanism for retry idempotency; duplicate detection should suppress repeated effects and return the prior/current equivalent successful result; honoring timeframe is provider-defined.

fresh_external_primary_evidence.source: Stripe API idempotent requests and error handling
fresh_external_primary_evidence.relevant_delta: Stable keys replay stored results, parameter drift under the same key is rejected, retention is finite, and transport/server failures can leave outcome indeterminate and require outcome observation.
Client-token idempotency is parameter- and scope-sensitive; same token with changed parameters fails IdempotentParameterMismatch.

fresh_external_primary_evidence.source: Lee et al. 2015, Implementing Linearizability at Large Scale and Low Latency (RIFL)
fresh_external_primary_evidence.relevant_delta: Exactly-once retry semantics require stable RPC identity and durable completion knowledge rather than retry intent alone.

coordination.duplicate_check: No current open PR found for provider contract/idempotency/reconciliation before branch creation.

parent_candidate.role: caller-bound exact V15/V16 B1/B2/B3 execution-generation authority candidate

architecture_delta.name: TYPED_PROVIDER_IDEMPOTENCY_AND_RECONCILIATION_CONTRACT
rules: Effect execution still requires the exact live caller-bound execution-generation fence; provider idempotency never mints effect authority.
Provider retry identity binds a stable idempotency key to one exact semantic request fingerprint plus provider/operation/scope and an explicit validity window.
Same key with different semantic request fingerprint is fail-closed.
A timeout/connection loss after B3 is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN unless independent provider evidence resolves it.
Read-only provider reconciliation is evidence, not a new effect; it therefore does not require the old ExecutionGenerationFence.
Generation turnover does not transfer uncertain-effect retry authority to a successor; successor may reconcile evidence but may not adopt the old effect execution.
architecture_delta.rollback: Drop the three additive candidate files/PR; parent #250 remains unchanged.

go_out_of_box_experiment.design: A physically separate disposable SQLite provider ledger durably commits exactly once under a stable idempotency key and then raises TimeoutError before Frank receives the acknowledgement. Frank must persist OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; after A->B execution-generation turnover B must be fenced from retry/adoption; a read-only lookup by key+request fingerprint must reconcile the existing provider result without a second write.

adjudication.counterhypothesis: REFUTED_FOR_THE_ACK_BLACKHOLE_CLASS: a boolean does not encode the provider-specific identity/fingerprint/scope/retention/mismatch/replay contract needed to justify retry decisions.
not_promoted_because: The provider was synthetic; F-V01-09 still requires a real provider timeout-after-acceptance/reconciliation receipt.
The historical downstream_retry_safe boolean has not yet been replaced in canonical schema/ClayCode.
Non-bypassable ordinary effect routing/lowering and exact current compiler/lowering evidence remain separate gates.
Verified provider outcome -> provenance-bound re-entry -> DONE/terminal receipt remains open.
Recovery generation/snapshot rollback remains an orthogonal open safety boundary.

work_impact.F-V01-09-EFFECT-AUTHORITY: Adds target-VPS supported synthetic mechanism evidence for the currently OPEN real_provider_unknown_outcome_reconciliation subcheck; status remains OPEN until real-provider evidence and canonical integration exist.
work_impact.F-V01-13-SECURITY-RECOVERY-OBSERVABILITY: Preserves the distinction between effect authority and post-failure evidence/reconciliation across generation turnover.
